text.p: Luis Champalimaud, president of Banco Totta e Acores, said he would consider revising the value of the Portuguese bank's 1996 dividend depending on the will of shareholders.
"I expect that a dividend will be distributed as previously announced, unless shareholders opt for a different dividend at the general assembly," he said in a statement.

Champalimaud said last Friday when he took over as president of the bank that BTA would distribute a dividend of 135 escudos per share. The market had expected a dividend of 190 escudos, unchanged from 1995.
BTA shares fell on the Lisbon bourse after the announcement of the lower than expected 1996 dividend payout.

Luis Champalimaud's father Antonio, who is the main shareholder of BTA, told Reuters this week he would ask the bank's general assembly for a significantly higher dividend. (( -- Lisbon newsroom +351-1-3538254 ))
